parsed_json.up: Select the first 1000 activity rows for IC50 assays on human single-protein target CHEMBL1741217 (DNA dC->dU-editing enzyme APOBEC-3G). Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and pchembl_value not null. Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value. Order by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Do not deduplicate.
